text: Synopsys, Inc. is a Delaware corporation listed on the Nasdaq Global Market. Its 2026 proxy statement names two owners of more than 5% of its common stock: entities associated with The Vanguard Group, Inc. (7.1%) and entities associated with BlackRock, Inc. (6.2%).
short: Synopsys is Nasdaq-listed; Vanguard (7.1%) and BlackRock (6.2%) are its only disclosed >5% holders.

source.name: Synopsys, Inc.: 2026 Proxy Statement (DEF 14A), 'Security Ownership of Certain Beneficial Owners and Management' (SEC EDGAR)
